purpose: Phase 11B1 provenance-bearing German phrase catalog source registry

sources.name: German Wiktionary via Kaikki/Wiktextract
sources.attribution: German Wiktionary contributors; structured extraction via Kaikki/Wiktextract
sources.redistribution_policy: Preserve attribution and applicable CC BY-SA/GFDL boundaries; raw snapshot remains local.

sources.name: Leipzig Corpora Collection downloadable German text corpora
sources.attribution: Leipzig Corpora Collection / Deutscher Wortschatz, Leipzig University
sources.redistribution_policy: Only explicitly downloaded text-corpus packages covered by the recorded CC-BY terms are eligible.

wiktionary_policy.source_type_policy: Preserve raw POS/tags/categories; normalized phrase types are derived only from explicit source markers.
wiktionary_policy.historical_policy: Historical-only only when entry-level evidence is historical or all available senses are historical; mixed evidence remains modern-eligible.

leipzig_policy.matching: exact normalized lexical-token sequence against source-backed phrase candidates
leipzig_policy.commonness: Store per-corpus occurrence/sentence counts and per-million rates separately; do not infer idiom/figurative type from frequency.

notes: Phase 11B1 intentionally does not perform phrase pronunciation, mosaic retrieval, writer ranking, API/UI surfacing, or runtime network access.
Additional future sources such as a licensed lyrics corpus must register as separate phrase_source/phrase_snapshot rows and never inherit Wiktionary or Leipzig provenance.
